title: 丰收游园

selectedMaster.selection: 人工首检：一名完整着装孩子、一匹完整白马、张臂笑脸、右后田垄、向日葵、唯一高处金日与完整土路均可见；未做透明、细部或倾斜验收。

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 1024×1536 portrait master artwork for a layered interactive tarot holographic card, The Sun, theme title “丰收游园”.
Primary request: exactly one joyful, age-appropriate child fully clothed in a warm ochre riding tunic, seated securely on exactly one complete white horse. The child smiles and opens both arms. Use a low camera angle: horse and rider slightly left, in a right-facing side-three-quarter profile; ripe field furrows lead away to the right rear. All four hooves must visibly contact one broad, continuous, solid earthen farm road that spans the lower bleed, with hoof-contact shadows; believable saddle, bridle, reins and riding balance. One huge golden sun sits high above with safe margin; sunflowers and a mature harvest field surround the road.
Scene: late-summer harvest garden, undulating grain fields, a low warm sunrise/sunset, no snow, no greenhouse, no ocean, no floating architecture.
Style: premium richly detailed painterly fantasy tarot art, crisp anatomy, natural materials, original composition.
Composition: vertical 2:3. Make the subject clearly distinct from the winter-greenhouse and seaside variants: horse left foreground, furrows pulling right-back, sun high. Keep 5% safety margin around face, hands and ears.
Lighting/palette: low-angle amber light; wheat gold, fresh field green and a restrained orange accent.
Constraints: exactly one clothed child and one white horse; no duplicate limbs, faces, horses or suns; no cropped/translucent animal, no floating/path sliver, no exposed torso; no text, border, watermark, checkerboard or baked holographic effects. The earthen road must remain a broad, continuous, grounded structure underneath every hoof.
generationRuns.conclusion: selected as master candidate; opaque RGB only, not a transparent layer or user-approved art

nextAction: 用户统一审美验收；技术与当前整改项复验已完成。

recordInstructions.files: 每项填写 path、sha256、bytes、图片width/height/mode与必要alpha统计。
recordInstructions.checks: 填写status、timestamp、reportPath、对应母版/资产哈希及人工结论；未做保持null/not-run。

productionDetail.foilMask: 向日葵花盘、马具与衣缘

productionDetail.samplePrinciple: 借鉴五样本的完整承接、真实透明、主题材质和极端倾斜复核，不按槽位强行套题材。
productionDetail.motion: 仅少量前景微光呼吸；主体、核心符号和承重结构不自动相对运动。
productionDetail.backgroundOwnership: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。
